motion.name: widget-assembly
motion.value: scroll progress 0.12–0.70; rounded pixel translate only
motion.purpose: Move exact dashboard widgets into their measured destinations without scaling, blur, or a transformed resting state.

motion.name: workspace-arrival
motion.purpose: Raise the complete Study Itinerary beneath the moving widgets.

motion.name: ambient-field
motion.value: 5.5–10s linear/ease-in-out loops; opacity and translate only
motion.purpose: Move product-derived rules, marks, and data labels behind the opening promise; fade fully before the workspace lands.

motion.name: feature-change
motion.purpose: Reveal one workspace screen after hiding the previous screen so text never composites.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: single crossfade threshold at scroll progress .46; ambient animation off
motion.purpose: Replace geometric travel and background loops with a direct state change.

narrative.overview: A calm academic field that turns into the real home workspace as the visitor scrolls. Exact copies of the period, priorities, practice queue, and activity widgets travel into their matching destinations. The opening field stays alive with subtle product-derived rules and data marks, then clears completely before the workspace lands. Product screens and plain language carry the rest of the page.
keyCharacteristics: Poster-scale Archivo Narrow typography on a cool-white opening field.
Four exact dashboard widgets that translate into a near-full-width Study Itinerary.
No blur, backdrop filter, scale, rotation, or transformed resting state on interface text.
A six-mode workspace viewer for courses, practice, planning, calendar and Canvas, tutor, and account history.
Ruled registers for steps, capabilities, courses, and privacy.
One signal indigo for action, active state, citations, and the connecting route.

rules.name: Product First
rules.body: Show the workspace before summarising what it can do.

rules.name: One Signal
rules.body: Indigo marks live state and action; it is not decorative acreage.

rules.name: Crisp Motion
rules.body: Moving interface text may translate and fade, but it must not scale, blur, rotate, or rest on a transform.

rules.name: Exact Widgets
rules.body: Hero artifacts reuse the same rendered components as their destinations; do not maintain look-alike copies.

rules.name: Plain Disclosure
rules.body: Example data is identified once in direct language; avoid visible design-process terminology.

rules.name: Mobile Evidence
rules.body: Compact layouts replace assembly with a static sequence and keep all six workspace tabs visible in a two-by-three grid.

dos: Keep the hero field subtle and fade it fully before the assembled screen becomes readable.
Map period, priorities, practice queue, and activity to the same widgets inside the dashboard.
Use actual course names, chapter structure, navigation, and sourced excerpts in public product screens.
Keep the six workspace modes keyboard accessible and visible on phones.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion with static background marks and a direct crossfade.
donts: Do not use stock student photography, abstract AI imagery, testimonial theatre, or generic feature cards.
Do not blur or scale interface text during motion.
Do not let the ambient field remain over the assembled dashboard.
Do not describe the design process, fidelity, proof, or component structure in visible marketing copy.
Do not invent counts, dates, course structures, or citations that conflict with repository data.
